purpose: CPU-only workflow transition and decision-value validation; all task and station parameters are simulation assumptions
prediction_selection: Select every fifth eligible window plus every eligible window containing a newly released successor; exclude later factual assignments, unknown external job arrivals, and changes to device availability.
decision_sampling: First and middle factual nearest-policy decision tick among states with an assignment and at least two legal candidate pairs; retain all CP-SAT proposals in the budget.
counterfactual_followup: Replay the exact factual prefix and apply one candidate at the selected tick, then deterministic nearest policy; future events never enter online models.
score_units: One unit per unfinished known job per predicted step, plus one per remaining map edge and one per expected service tick; capacity contention and distance are tie breakers. No coefficient search.
scope: Confirmation uses previously seen public maps with new audited task patterns and seeds, not unseen layouts or real hospital data.
